what: NRC fixtures for tests/test_radiation.py. NRC web content is a US Government work, not subject to copyright (nrc.gov/site-help/disclaimer, read 25 Nov 2026). Personal names (NRC Notified By, HQ OPS Officer, Person (Organization), and the names in update lines) are replaced with [name] or [names]; Elements' parser reads none of them.

files.events_20260211.html: Cut from the NRC's real Event Notification Report page for 11 Feb 2026 (events 58149, 58151, 58160), from its h1 to the end of the last event; each event text cut to its first line. Copied from the public GitHub repository twitchax/downpower (crates/downpower-ingest/tests/fixtures/events/). The blank County field holds a NUL byte, as on the NRC's page.
files.events_20120109.html: Cut from the NRC's real Event Notification Report page for 9 Jan 2012 in the same page template (events 47580 ISFSI, 47581 Power Reactor with its unit table, 47578 Fuel Cycle Facility), from the same repository.
files.events_20260224_rebuilt.html: Rebuilt, not copied: events 58168 (Hope Creek 1, Unusual Event, loss of all offsite power, later terminated) and 58170 (Fermi 2, Non Emergency) of the NRC's report for 24 Feb 2026, in the page template of the two real pages, from the field values read on 25 Nov 2026. Event texts cut to the lines the parser reads.
files.index_2026_rebuilt.html: Rebuilt: the report links of the NRC's 2026 event notification index as read on 25 Nov 2026 (and two older ones), without the page's own markup.
files.PowerStatus_rebuilt.txt: Rebuilt: the first three dates (25, 24 and 23 Nov 2026, 95 units each) of the NRC's year file 2026PowerStatus.txt, in its pipe-delimited format (ReportDt|Unit|Power), from the values read on 25 Nov 2026. The real file's line endings were not seen; the parser reads CRLF and LF.
